newsitem.title: USA: Alexion board adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Alexion board adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: Alexion Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday its board has approved a shareholder rights plan.
Under the plan, each shareholder will receive a dividend of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding Alexion common share, it said.
The dividend distribution will be made on March 6, payable to stockholders of record on that date. The rights which are not taxable to stockholders, will expire on March 6, 2007.

Leonard Bell, president and chief executive officer, said the rights are designed to assure that all of Alexion's stockholders receive fair and equal treatment in the event of any proposed takeover of the company.

It is also intended to guard against partial tender offers, open market accumulations and other abusive tactics to gain control of the company without paying all stockholders a control premium, he said.
He noted, however, that the adoption of the plan was not in response to any specific takeover threat or proposal.

The rights will be exercisable if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of Alexion's common stock or announces a tender offer that would result in ownership by a person or group of 20 percent or more of the common stock.
Each right will entitle stockholders to buy one one-hundredth of a new series of junior participating preferred share at an exercise price of $75.

If Alexion is acquired in a merger or other business combination after a person has bought 20 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock, each right will entitle the holder to buy, at the right's then-current exercise price, a number of the acquiring company's common shares having a market value of twice such price.

If a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of Alexion's outstanding common stock, each right will entitle its holder, other than the person or group member to buy at the right's then-current exercise price, a number of Alexion's common shares with a market value of twice such price.

After a person or group acquires ownership of 20 percent or more, and before an acquisition of 50 percent or more, of the common stock, the board may exchange the rights, other than those owned by the person or group, at an exchange ratio of common share or one one-hundredth of a share of the junior preferred stock per right.
Before the acquisition by a person or group of a 20 percent stake, the rights are redeemable for one cent a right at the option of the board.

Alexion is engaged in the development of selective immunotherapeutic drugs that are generally designed to inhibit the disease-causing segments of the immune system while preserving the disease-preventing aspects of the immune system.
